upload_file_to_hub: upload a single file to a Hugging Face Hub repository with implicit path resolution
upload_directory_with_filters: upload a directory to the Hub with include and exclude glob patterns to filter files
upload_with_scheduled_commits: schedule recurring commits every N minutes to upload files to a Hub repository
upload_private_dataset: upload a private dataset or model to the Hub with explicit repo type and private flag
sync_space_with_hub: sync a local Space directory with the Hub, uploading new files and deleting removed ones
